C1.worst_defect: On the phone the home header shows only 'Docs' and 'Live demo' plus search and a chevron, so 'At the till' (the page my staff need) is two taps away. The hero line 'Your own store needs the plugin on your Vendure server first' speaks to my developer, not to me.

C2.worst_defect: The home 'Live demo or your own store' table lists 'Refund a sale at the till', with Yes for the demo and No for my store on plugin 0.3.0. The phone hero shows the till on a phone, yet Limitations says 'tablets, phones and iPad not tested'.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 comparison table; home.phone.01 vs limitations

C3.worst_defect: To settle a Dashboard refund, the site says it needs 'two Admin API calls' and the refund otherwise 'stays Pending'. As an owner I can't do that myself, so every refund depends on my freelancer.
C3.where: home.desktop.02 table row 'Refund a sale at the till'; limitations

C4.worst_defect: The 'At the till' cashier guide mixes demo-only steps into the instructions for a real store: 'On the live demo, type a Customer note…' and a 'Refund at the till (live demo only)' section with 'Refund steps on the live demo'. Separately, the Troubleshooting 'Till updates line' moves into errorCode jargon ('register_session_already_open', 'register_closure_number_invalid').

C5.worst_defect: The closure screenshot ('Register closed / Closure #1 / Counted €120.09 / Expected €120.09 / Exact') has loose gaps and a nested double frame. The cashier-sheet image is small inside a large padded frame.

C6.worst_defect: The phone top bar shows only 'Docs' and 'Live demo', so Quick start and At the till are hidden behind the chevron. The hero till image is cropped down to two product cards, so on a phone I can't see what the till looks like.

C7.worst_defect: Every sitemap lastmod is the capture day, whether or not the page changed. Quick-start LCP on mobile is 2.6 s (Lighthouse 97). Neither matters to me at the counter.

overall_worst.defect: The 'At the till' guide is the page I would hand my two staff, and it mixes live-demo-only features into the steps for a real store on plugin 0.3.0: 'On the live demo, type a Customer note…' and a whole 'Refund at the till (live demo only)' section with 'Refund steps on the live demo'. Staff who practise on the demo learn a till refund and a customer note that our shop will not have.
overall_worst.fix: Take the demo-only items out of the cashier steps and put them in one clearly labelled 'Only on the live demo' box at the end of the page, or move them to the home comparison table, so the page my staff read describes only what our till does.
